question: Who made the pass? The passer of each labelled BAS action, from detections only, scored apart from event detection.
status: exploratory (owner decision 2026-10-22, CPU only); written before any scoring
units: every shots clip with a GPU run (.cache/gpu/<w>) and its labels; actions deduplicated on (match, half, absolute frame, label)
inputs: metric_v3s_link.parquet: v3s_link ball and player tracks in pitch metres; no ground truth used to choose
rule A (primary): at the label frame f: the ball row nearest f within +-5 frames; actor = the player detection at f nearest the ball in metres, if within 3 m; else no actor
rule B: the (player, frame) pair nearest the ball over frames f-10 .. f+5 (ball rows at those frames), within 3 m
truth: actor detection -> ground-truth person by eval_soccertrack_v2.match_feet at its frame -> player_id; right if equal to the label's player_id
ceiling: the labelled player matched to some player detection at f (detected at all)
primary metric: passes (PASS, HIGH PASS, CROSS) on matches v3 never saw (117092, 128057, 132831): share right of all labelled passes, Wilson 95%; also precision (right / actor given) and coverage
also reported: every player action label; matches v3 was trained on, separately (ball optimistic)
